hypotheses.justification: `[NumberField L]` is a section variable that is taken because `L` appears in the statement. Nothing in the statement or proof uses it. `AutomorphicForm.sigmaTensor K L A σ` is defined in a section that assumes only `[Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] [CommRing A] [Algebra K A]`. The ring structure on `L ⊗[K] Kv` needs only those instances. `Kv` needs `NumberField K` for `IsDedekindDomain (𝓞 K)`, but nothing needs `NumberField L`. The proof rewrites with the local `sigmaTensor_pow`, which is stated under the same minimal assumptions, and then applies `map_mul` to the ring hom `sigmaTensor`. Neither step uses `NumberField L`. The statement is true without it, so it can be removed with `omit [NumberField L] in`, in addition to the existing `omit [IsGalois K L]`.
